query.title: Genre or keyword to search
query.description: Whatever you would type into the Kindle store search bar. Adding a phrase like self published tends to surface more indie titles.

maxSearchPages.title: Maximum search result pages
maxSearchPages.description: How many pages of Kindle store search results to walk through.

maxAuthors.title: Maximum authors to process (0 = unlimited)
maxAuthors.description: Stop after this many new authors have been processed in this run.

crawlAuthorSites.title: Also read the author's own website
crawlAuthorSites.description: Follows the plain text website address if one is written into the author bio.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Maximum pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Budget of pages per website when the author's own site is crawled.

minimumScore.title: Minimum quality score to keep an address
minimumScore.description: Zero to one hundred. Fifty five keeps medium and high confidence, seventy five keeps high confidence only.
